findings.claim: For a new shared field, the current UI destination is @repo/ui/components/native and @repo/ui/components/web, with matching names and props; the web field must be DOM-native and the native field must remain within the native boundary.

The reusable field should present UI while API behavior belongs in the established domain/API client seam. For a new API capability, use Sanctuary API's oRPC v2 /api/v1 command or query, declared in the capability catalog with its subdomain card and contract; clients must not add direct database paths or import the frozen pre-v1 @repo/core/api surface.

The older workflow's tRPC, Zustand source-of-truth, packages/ui/packages/core placement, fixed palette, and unconditional plan-approval gate conflict with or are superseded by the current platform rules. Current records specify oRPC v2, distinguish @repo/core and @repo/ui boundaries, route UI colors through world recipes, and define the current API architecture.

No source code, installed declarations, capability catalog, runtime hook, or canary evidence was provided or inspected in this bounded task, so exact API capability, file paths, runtime status, and implementation compatibility remain unverified.
